messages:
Elaine (Docs): Heads-up: putting together a short 'audit evidence' section for SOC2 docs. Aim: JSON schema, export examples, provenance manifest, and wording for retention + legal-hold. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4921
Sam (Security): include note that changing redaction rules can change exported contents and we should recommend provenance (hash + schema_version + export_timestamp).
Elaine (Docs): Draft schema snippet: {
  "evidence_id": "uuid", "collected_at": "2026-03-15T10:00:00Z", "tenant_id": "acct_123", "events": 42, "retention_days": 365, "legal_hold": false, "schema_version": "v2", "provenance_hash": "sha256:..."
}
Matt (SDK): Note: exports are JSONL with schema_version per record. I'll add a tiny v1->v2 normalizer in SDK and link it.
Nijah (Legal): Wording: "By default, Redwood retains and makes available audit evidence for export for 365 days; customers may configure per-tenant retention where permitted by contract. Evidence under legal hold is retained until release and is exempt from standard TTL deletion." Approve.
Kai (PM): Customer ask: if they shorten retention, can they bulk-export prior to deletion? Add mention of export API and legal_hold APIs.
Elaine (Docs): cURL export example: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export?tenant=acct_123&from=2026-01-01&to=2026-03-01" -o export.jsonl
Matt (SDK): Also include manifest example: {"files": ["export.jsonl"], "export_timestamp": "2026-03-15T10:05:00Z", "exported_by": "elaine.docs@redwood.ai", "manifest_hash": "sha256:..."}
Elaine (Docs): Found a broken anchor in docs/retention.md (#default-retention vs #default-ttl). deploy-bot, please open tiny linkfix PR.
deploy-bot: Checklist noted: linkfix PR, changelog entry, add SDK helper link when available.
Sam (Security): Add a short auditor note: provide exported bundle + manifest; recommend storing off-platform for long-term retention.
Elaine (Docs): I'll update the PR with the revised wording, schema, small curl/python examples, provenance explanation, and mention of SDK helper. Thanks all :pray:
